summary: Iteration 9 — validated Bengali order notifications, notification-click → order detail navigation, admin order card per-status color backgrounds, and regressions (guest order skip, mark-read/mark-all-read, anti-copy on storefront/opt-out on admin). All 7 backend pytest cases pass; all 3 frontend flows pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1163 — admin_update_order calls push_notification(o['userId'], ...) unconditionally. For guest orders (userId=None) push_notification will broadcast the Bengali status update to ALL customers (see push_notification line 383-385). Recommend guarding with `if o.get('userId'):` similar to order-creation guard at line 1094. Not covered by the current test-set but a real regression risk if an admin updates a guest order's status.

Notifications.jsx:43-47 — visiting /notifications auto-triggers markAllRead(), which means the 'clicked notif becomes read' behavior is trivially satisfied (all become read on page mount). Consider removing the blanket markAllRead on mount so per-item read state is meaningful (or keep and document).
admin/Orders.jsx overall LGTM — data-testid, cardBg mapping, and status badge all wired correctly.
